title: The Data of Formants of Tibetan Trilingual Learners' English Vowels Production
why_promising: Primary English diphthong production by Tibetan-Chinese-English trilingual learners. Public CC BY 4.0 Mendeley Data deposit explicitly reports F1/F2 trajectories and peak formant values for /aɪ eɪ ɔɪ aʊ oʊ/, participant demographic/linguistic metadata, Praat-based acoustic analysis, and careful manual annotation and validation. Public record exposes participant-background DOCX plus male/female TXT measurement files.
open_question: Enumerate and download all deposit files; parse the TXT trajectory/measurement structure and participant metadata; verify exact timepoint/window definitions, units, token identifiers, manual-annotation scope, speaker counts, and whether any automatic extraction fields require separate provenance before core admission.
